description: Set who is credited as author on the brand's side pages, per kind. Values: a BlogAuthor id (from list_blog_authors; must be an active author of the brand), "none" (show no author; the brand is credited instead), or null (follow the blog default author). Omit a kind to leave it unchanged. Applies to pages that have no author set of their own.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

comparison.description: Comparison pages: author id, "none", or null to follow the blog default author.

feature.description: Feature/spotlight and other long-form side pages: author id, "none", or null to follow the blog default author.

name: set_side_page_author_defaults
